assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: polished art-direction comparison board for choosing a mobile app mascot.
Primary request: Create a large landscape 3:2 board with FOUR equal panels in a clean 2-by-2 grid. Each panel shows EXACTLY THE SAME original character identity and same friendly neutral full-body pose; only rendering medium changes. Clear typography, very spacious, no clipped limbs.
The application is Gamify, a broad habit, skills and side-project quest app. Its observed visual language is Sunset Plum: dark background #231A2B, lavender #B79BFF, peach #F4A98C, warm pale gold #F7D699, mint #74C79C, light background #FAF6F8. Rounded crisp cards, soft tactile depth, encouraging calm peer-coach. This is original brand design exploration; no existing commercial mascot, no owl, no brand imitation.
Subject identity held across all panels: Questling, compact warm-gold rounded seed/spark creature, one soft asymmetrical swept crown tuft (not a fire flame), two tiny mitten hands, two small plum feet, violet FOUR-POINT sparkle badge on forehead, small dark plum oval eyes with ONE tiny highlight each and small friendly smile, no white eye sclera, no clothes. Head and body one compact volume, hands close to body. Calm approachable, not babyish, no huge anime eyes.
Panel 1 top-left, exact title "01 · Soft shaded 2D"; subtitle "Recommended". Crisp flat filled rounded forms, single broad soft-edged peach shadow band lower-right, thin consistent plum outline approx 1.5–2% character silhouette width, upper-left light, no glossy specular shine, clean vector-like editorial mascot rendering.
Panel 2 top-right, title "02 · Flat geometric"; subtitle "Simplest system". Identical silhouette, face, badge and pose, completely flat solid fills with no gradients or texture, more geometric simplified shapes, consistent plum outline.
Panel 3 bottom-left, title "03 · Matte clay 3D"; subtitle "Tactile alternative". Same identity now sculpted matte clay toy, soft diffuse studio lighting, subtle matte microtexture, no plastic gloss.
Panel 4 bottom-right, title "04 · Storybook gouache"; subtitle "Painterly alternative". Same identity and pose painted gouache, dry brushed edges, visible soft paper grain, restrained hand-painted shadow.
Composition: each panel warm off-white #FAF6F8 with plum title at top, large character centered. Tiny square plum swatch lower-right showing a small full-body duplicate to illustrate theme presence. Main board border/background very pale peach, fine separators, sophisticated and uncluttered. No fake app UI, no extra copy beyond titles/subtitles. No watermark. Four-point badge must stay consistent, no five-point stars.

Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: mobile-app mascot shortlist comparison board.
Primary request: A polished wide landscape board comparing FIVE original mascot proposals in EXACTLY ONE consistent drawing style. Clean five equal vertical columns, full-body neutral pose above and smaller enthusiastic but gentle celebration pose below. Each column has its exact name at top. Very spacious precise alignment, same character scale and optical weight. Main warm off-white #FAF6F8 background with a horizontal plum #231A2B band across bottom showing the small celebration poses. No app screens. No additional headings or body text.
The application is Gamify, a broad habit, skills and side-project quest app. Its observed visual language is Sunset Plum: dark background #231A2B, lavender #B79BFF, peach #F4A98C, warm pale gold #F7D699, mint #74C79C, light background #FAF6F8. Rounded crisp cards, soft tactile depth, encouraging calm peer-coach. This is original brand design exploration; no existing commercial mascot, no owl, no brand imitation.
LOCKED style for all five: soft shape-shaded 2D, clean crisp vector-like fills, round consistent plum outline approx 1.5–2% silhouette width, one broad simple shadow patch lower-right, upper-left light. Flat major color regions, small dark plum oval eyes each with one tiny cream highlight, no white sclera, no giant anime eyes. Tiny round smile, short rounded limbs, warm attentive friendly peer. At most 4 main colors per creature. No detailed fur, no scales, no fabric texture, no glow, no plastic, no complex gradients. Character identity must repeat faithfully between top neutral and bottom happy pose.
Column 1 exact name "Questling": compact warm gold #F7D699 round seed/spark body, one asymmetrical soft swept crown tuft, pale cream face area, tiny gold mitten hands and plum feet, violet four-point sparkle forehead badge. Not a burning flame, no fire effects. This crown and forehead badge identify only this creature.
Column 2 name "Lantern Moth": compact friendly small moth with rounded lavender wings folded tightly near body, gold/cream face and belly patch, plum small body, two short thick round-tip antennae. Large readable face, no owl/bird features, no beak. No forehead badge and no self-emission glow. Both neutral and celebration keep wings compact.
Column 3 name "Trail Fox": small rounded peach fox with cream muzzle and belly, two rounded triangular ears, short legs, ONE curled chunky peach tail with cream tip tucked close beside body within a square footprint. Lavender neckerchief optional tiny solid shape; no forehead badge. Small oval eyes and smile, no detailed fur.
Column 4 name "Questbara": compact golden-peach capybara, rounded rectangular head with tiny ears and blunt gentle muzzle, chunky little body, relaxed small oval eyes, tiny lavender scarf, no backpack, no forehead badge. Calm but visibly smiling in celebration, arms slightly raised.
Column 5 name "Pocket Dragon": compact lavender dragon, cream belly, two short soft gold horns, tiny mitten arms, little gold round triangular back spikes, very small tucked wings and curled short tail. Rounded and friendly, no claws or teeth, no forehead badge. No elaborate fantasy gear.
Composition: make neutral poses in top 65% on offwhite, celebration poses in lower plum band 25%, labels separated top 10%. Plum tiny bodies in lower band need cream/lavender edges. Exact labels only. No badges, ratings, arrows, props or extra decorations. No watermark.

Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: art-direction proof for future user-generated course characters in Gamify.
Input image: the provided mascot shortlist is a STYLE REFERENCE, not an edit target. Follow its soft-shaded 2D drawing grammar, rounded plum contours, compact friendly shapes and modest oval eyes. Generate a NEW family comparison board.
Primary request: Create a large landscape 3:2 artboard with six equal panels in a clean 3-column 2-row grid. All six creatures belong unmistakably to ONE same illustration system, yet are different species and silhouettes. Full body visible, equal optical height, neutral gently smiling pose, front with slight three-quarter turn, consistent upper-left light and baseline. Pale offwhite #FAF6F8 panel backgrounds with small plum #231A2B theme tile in each panel showing a SMALL copy of that same character. Uniform simple rounded typography, spacious, restrained.
LOCKED art grammar: clean soft shape-shaded 2D, flat main fills, one broad peach/plum shadow patch lower-right, rounded plum outline at consistent ~1.5–2% character silhouette width. Modest dark plum oval eyes with one tiny cream highlight, NO white sclera or anime eyes. Small curved smile, large rounded compact head/body, tiny mitten arms and short feet. No textures, no realistic fur, no rendered metal, no plastic gloss, no gradients/glow, no complex gear. 3–5 principal colors.
Top-left exact label "Official · Questling": faithfully reproduce the gold Questling character from reference's first column, cream heartlike face area, lavender FOUR-POINT forehead badge, small plum feet, one rounded swept crown crest, hands near body. Only this official creature has the forehead badge plus gold body plus crown combination.
Top-middle label "Coding · Robot": original small lavender and cream robot with rounded square head and small rounded torso, simple face, short segmented arms with mitten hands. One tiny peach antenna, no code lettering, no logo, no forehead badge. Matte illustrated robot, not mechanical 3D.
Top-right label "Music · Otter": peach and cream rounded otter, lavender simple headphones as its ONE prop. Tail tucked close, tiny paws. No instrument needed, no music note decoration, no forehead badge.
Bottom-left label "Fitness · Bear": mint #74C79C bear with cream muzzle/belly, short rounded ears, simple peach headband as ONE prop, relaxed supportive pose, no muscles or dumbbell, no forehead badge.
Bottom-middle label "Mindfulness · Tortoise": sage-mint small tortoise, cream belly and face, lavender simple shell with at most two big segment lines, slow friendly relaxed pose, round eye construction same as others, no forehead badge.
Bottom-right label "Cooking · Cat": peach and cream round cat, short thick tail tucked within silhouette, one small lavender chef hat as ONE prop, same simple facial system no whisker detail, no apron or tools, no forehead badge.
Text labels only, exact spelling. Preserve equal face scale, line weight, light direction and rendering. Make each character fit a square footprint. The family is calm, curious and encouraging, not babyish. No scenery, no watermark, no imitation of commercial mascots.

Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: standalone original mascot neutral-pose concept cutout for true-size mobile UI review.
Input image: STYLE AND CHARACTER IDENTITY REFERENCE. Reproduce ONLY the Questling in the FIRST COLUMN of the provided shortlist, not the other creatures or the board. New clean full-body single-character asset.
Primary request: A SINGLE Questling centered on a genuinely TRANSPARENT background, full body visible with about 7% empty padding around, square canvas. Same cream heartlike face patch, warm pale gold #F7D699 body, lavender #B79BFF FOUR-POINT forehead sparkle badge, two modest dark plum oval eyes each with a single tiny cream highlight, small friendly curved smile, peach tiny cheeks, two short gold mitten hands and two plum feet. Compact rounded seed creature with one asymmetric sideways swept soft crown crest with rounded tip, avoid sharp fire/flame silhouette. It should feel like a little companion rather than a streak icon. No clothes or prop.
Rendering: restrained soft shape-shaded 2D, crisp flat main color regions, one simple broad peach shadow shape lower-right, uniform round dark plum #231A2B contour about 1.5–2% character silhouette width. No glossy highlight streaks on body, no white sclera, no texture or huge anime eyes. Upper-left light indicated only through broad shade shapes, no actual 3D rendering. Character should remain readable at 50px with clearly separated eye, mouth and badge. Hands rest close to sides, friendly attentive neutral expression, slight three-quarter view. No cast shadow, no ground ellipse, no glow, no background color, no text or watermark. Preserve same limb count and body proportions as the Questling reference.

refinement.prompt: Edit this course-character style board. Preserve the six-panel layout, exact labels, official Questling identity (cream heart face, violet four-point forehead badge, golden crest), robot, otter, bear and tortoise silhouettes, composition, relative scale and palette. Apply one unified restrained shape-shaded 2D rendering to all six: remove white body gleam strips/specular highlights and glossy gradients, replace with broad flat color regions and only one or two large flat shadow shapes, consistent rounded plum outline and small dark oval eyes with one tiny cream eye catchlight. Change ONLY the Cooking Cat species silhouette: a visibly round domestic cat face with rounded cheeks and short muzzle, small triangle ears, cream muzzle area, slender rounded upward curl tail with NO bushy fox tail or cream fox tip, same lavender chef hat. Make chef face clearly different from the Trail Fox. No extra props/text. Clean pale off-white background, no texture or 3D effects.

note: These are exploratory review assets. The written style specification is a target, not a guarantee that every generated detail conforms. Existing concepts/ and styles/ artwork was present before this task and preserved.
